justification: Test infrastructure changes -- no production code modified. Pre-push hook blocks bad pushes. No DB, no API, no user-facing changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: No DB interaction. Tests mock all DB calls via conftest_mocks.py sys.modules injection.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If service files add new top-level imports, conftest_mocks.py needs updating -- tests fail loudly at collection.

functions.name: pytest_generate_tests
functions.input: keyword arguments from pydantic BaseModel subclass constructors
functions.output: instance with attributes set from kwargs, supports model_validate classmethod
functions.if_none: returns empty instance with no attributes set

values.if_missing: service imports fail -- tests error at collection

break_it.scenario: New service imports native dep not in _MOCK_MODULES
break_it.what_happens: pytest collection fails with ModuleNotFoundError -- pre-push blocks push
break_it.how: Failure is loud. Fix: add module to _MOCK_MODULES.

break_it.scenario: Mock overrides a module that tests actually need to exercise
break_it.what_happens: Tests pass vacuously because MagicMock returns MagicMock for any attribute
break_it.how: Only mocking psycopg2/requests/pyproj/audit_trail. Tests assert concrete values not MagicMock.

break_it.scenario: Pre-push hook runs with Python that has no pytest installed
break_it.what_happens: Hook errors with ModuleNotFoundError for pytest, push is blocked with clear message
break_it.how: requirements-test.txt documents deps. Error message tells user what to install.

post_merge.manual_verify: Run git config core.hooksPath .githooks to pick up pre-push hook
